app_names.case-agent: Case update agent (acts on the case system)

retention.T0: Log entry only. Retained 90 days, then destroyed with information manager approval. Held if the model is under recall.
retention.T1: Record package retained with the business record it became part of; follows that record's disposal class.
retention.T2: Record package including sources, checks and reviewer sign-off; retained as long as the decision record.
retention.T3: Record package including system prompt, agent instructions, tool calls and activity log; retained as long as the decision record.
